subject.title: fix(gateway): hide stream-error sentinel from chat history

question: Should OpenClaw accept the display-only contract that hides a provenanced stream-error sentinel when later assistant content exists in the same user turn?
rationale: The code path is correct and narrowly tested, but it deliberately changes which assistant history rows clients receive, so maintainer intent should settle the message-delivery contract before merge.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Accept the narrow display-only suppression while preserving persisted sentinel rows and standalone failed-turn visibility.

options.title: Request contract changes
options.body: Ask the contributor to adjust the same-turn boundary or visibility guardrails before merge if this display behavior is too broad or too narrow.

options.title: Reject suppression
options.body: Close or hold the PR if maintainers want all persisted assistant error rows to remain visible regardless of later assistant content.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow display-only suppression while preserving persisted sentinel rows and standalone failed-turn visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the PR and merged the related failed-turn display baseline this PR refines.
